# murtadhaqahtan.github.io

> Personal GitHub Pages host of Murtadha Qahtan. Products: Layout Fixer, a Windows 10/11 app (Microsoft Store ID 9N32C01ML8D1, US$1.99) that fixes text typed in the wrong keyboard layout with one hotkey (e.g. "ghbdtn" → "привет", "hgsghl ugd;l" → "السلام عليكم"), and RTL Text Fixer, a Windows 10/11 app (Microsoft Store release pending) that makes Arabic, Persian, Urdu, Kurdish, Pashto, Sindhi, Uyghur, Hebrew and Yiddish text display correctly in apps without right-to-left support (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Unity, Blender), and Mic Mute Hotkey, a Windows 10/11 app (Microsoft Store ID 9NXGCCP0WGZS, US$2.99) that mutes the microphone in every app with one global shortcut, with push-to-talk and an on-screen indicator.

## Projects
- [Layout Fixer](https://murtadhaqahtan.github.io/layout-fixer-site/): fix text typed in the wrong keyboard layout on Windows (Arabic, Persian, Kurdish, Hebrew, Russian, Ukrainian, Greek, Turkish Q ⇄ English or any pair). Full summary: https://murtadhaqahtan.github.io/layout-fixer-site/llms.txt
- [Layout Fixer in the Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9N32C01ML8D1)
- [RTL Text Fixer](https://murtadhaqahtan.github.io/rtl-text-fixer-site/): connected letters and correct right-to-left order for apps that break Arabic-script and Hebrew text (Arabic reshaper + Unicode bidi). Full summary: https://murtadhaqahtan.github.io/rtl-text-fixer-site/llms.txt
- [Mic Mute Hotkey](https://murtadhaqahtan.github.io/mic-mute-site/): system-wide microphone mute for Windows 10/11 – global shortcut (default Win+Alt+A), push-to-talk / push-to-mute, always-on-top "Muted"/"Live" indicator, tray icon, 15 languages, offline. Full summary: https://murtadhaqahtan.github.io/mic-mute-site/llms.txt
- [Mic Mute Hotkey in the Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NXGCCP0WGZS)
